# CV-4 parity fixtures

Synthetic; no personal data. Generated by
[`tools/cv4_fixtures.py`](../../../../../tools/cv4_fixtures.py) with NumPy,
OpenCV and scikit-learn from the yet_zero virtualenv.

Do not edit these files by hand. Rerun the generator instead. They are consumed
by `crates/yet-core/tests/cv4_parity.rs`; see
[`docs/fixtures/CV-4.md`](../../../../../docs/fixtures/CV-4.md) for the format
and for how to add recorded eye-ROI frames.
